open: Gameweek six. Two derbies, a league leader under investigation, and one man still looking for his first point. Here's how it lines up.

beats: Kobbie Mainoo Fan. Top of the table, unbeaten in four, and still under investigation. Allegedly.
Hall scored thirteen last week. Isak goes into the weekend carrying a knock, because of course he does.
Trophy Hunters. Bryant has won three on the bounce, the best form in the league. The group chat has suffered enough.
Semenyo, Tzolis and Brobbey all carry knocks. Thirty-six points between them last week. Start praying, Bryant.
Baha leads the series five to two, and the model makes him favourite. Again.
Cold Palmers. Parker says he's winning Manager of the Month. The model says nine percent. Brave.
Palmer, Mainoo, Rice and Jacquet all carry knocks. That's not a midfield, that's a physio's waiting room.
Devils U21s. Five games, five defeats, no points. And somehow PJ still leads this derby four to three.
Gibbs-White tops the eleven. Not a single flag among PJ's starters. Fully fit. Just shite.
The model has Parker a narrow favourite. PJ has won four of their seven meetings. Don't trust it.
I Am a Baleba. Ethan put fifty-four on PJ last week, his best of the season. PJ is still recovering.
Haaland goes to Anfield. Ethan's entire weekend rests on one Norwegian android.
The Soaring Gulls. CJ has scored two hundred and forty, the most in the league. Quietly terrifying.
Gabriel heads the eleven, at home to Leeds. Tavernier and Emersonn close behind. Yes, Emersonn.
Ethan leads the series four to three. The model still prefers CJ. The model has never met Ethan.
In It to McGinn It. Nate has lost two straight, by a point and by twenty-six. One hurts. One's a crime scene.
Fernandes leads the eleven, at home to Spurs. Porro and Rashford are seventy-five percent, which on Nate's luck means zero.
Team Jacob. Two straight defeats as well, by four and by one. Somebody's losing run ends on Saturday.
Saka leads the eleven, at home to Leeds. Mbeumo hosts Spurs too, so Old Trafford decides this one.
First ever meeting, and the model makes Jacob a clear favourite. Nate, it's been a pleasure.

close: That's the gameweek. Lineups in before Saturday's deadline. Get yourself on the record, and try not to embarrass yourself.
